17% is exp(mean over design points of the per-point mean log width ratio) - 1. Over the 1,874,189 null-alternative datasets where both intervals are finite, the geometric mean of the ratio is 8.7% (N>=75: 5.6% against 6.4%). The text says 'where both intervals were finite it was wider ... by 17% on average', which reads as dataset-weighted; small designs with few finite intervals get the same weight as large ones.
